description: A sample project demonstrating the prd.json format consumed by tdd.sh.

tasks.title: User registration endpoint
tasks.description: Implement a POST /register endpoint that accepts email and password, validates input, and creates a new user record.
acceptance_criteria: POST /register returns 201 with user ID on success
POST /register returns 400 when email is missing or malformed
POST /register returns 409 when email is already taken

tasks.title: User login endpoint
tasks.description: Implement a POST /login endpoint that authenticates with email and password, returning a JWT on success.
acceptance_criteria: POST /login returns 200 with a JWT token on valid credentials
POST /login returns 401 on invalid email or password
JWT contains user ID and expires after 24 hours

tasks.title: Health check endpoint
tasks.description: Implement a GET /health endpoint that returns service status.
